Subject: Invoice routing and VAT: split remit across ClearWave entities

Hi Monica / Marissa,

Thanks for the recent pilot work — CFO has asked us to consolidate Redwood charges but split the invoice for payment and tax reasons. We need the November invoice to be formatted so our AP can route amounts to two legal entities:

- ClearWave Health, Inc. (US) — 70% of total; US entity will handle payment (no VAT).
- ClearWave Health Ltd (EU) — 30% of total; EU entity will self-assess VAT (reverse-charge).

Request: can you produce a single PDF invoice with two billed-to sections (or line-level entity mapping) and clear remit instructions for each portion? AP also needs the bank details and the VAT ID for the EU entity on the invoice.

Attached is our PO for reference (PO_1324.pdf). We need this in our system by COB Nov 30 if possible.

Please loop in Billing Ops / Finance as needed.

Emma

Hi Emma — thanks for the clear ask. We can do a split-invoice presentation that meets AP requirements. Proposed approach:

- Produce one PDF invoice that contains two "billing blocks" with their own billed-to VAT/Tax IDs and remit addresses.
- Line-level mapping so our GL can allocate 70%/30% to the respective legal entity cost centers.
- Add explicit "payment steering" notes in the invoice footer and include separate bank details for each entity.
- Include metadata for your AP to machine-parse: entity_code, tax_id, remit_account.

Next steps (for internal owners):
- Rishi: confirm we can attach entity metadata to the invoice PDF and push separate payment instructions.
- Marissa: confirm tax copy / VAT text for reverse-charge.

I attached a quick invoice_split_plan.xlsx with the proposed line split and cost-center mapping. Rishi — can you confirm implementation timeline? Emma — if that works I will draft the invoice and send a preview.

Thanks,
Monica

On Fri, Nov 27, 2026 at 14:02 Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com> wrote:
> Monica: Proposed approach...

We can implement the split with the following technical notes:

- Invoice structure: primary PDF with two "Bill To" sections. Each will have a unique invoice_reference tag (e.g., CW-INV-202611-01-US and CW-INV-202611-01-EU) but consolidated under a single invoice header so accounting sees one document.
- Metadata fields embedded in the PDF XMP and in our billing API: entity_code, tax_id, bank_iban, contact_email, cost_center. This allows your AP system to auto-route.
- For payment routing we will include two sets of bank coordinates and explicit instructions: "Payment for lines 1-4 to ClearWave Health, Inc." and "Payment for lines 5-6 to ClearWave Health Ltd."
- VAT: we will include the EU VAT ID and the standard reverse-charge line: "VAT to be self-assessed by the recipient per Article 194(1) VAT Directive." Please confirm the exact VAT ID.

Timeline: I can generate a draft invoice and a machine-readable CSV mapping (remit_mapping.csv) by Nov 30 09:00 PST. Final PDF will be delivered same day after your confirmation. If legal needs a signed amendment to the purchase order we can route via DocuSign (estimate +2 business days).

Risks / notes: if your ERP cannot accept multi-entity billed blocks we can issue two PDFs and link them via a single PO reference, but that will require AP to reconcile across two invoices.

--
Rishi Malhotra
Billing Operations Lead, Redwood Inference
